title: Eph 2: created in Christ for good works
source_text: XXII. Quo respiciens idem Apostolus, Eph. 2. dicit nos Christo convivificatos, & servatos esse gratia per fidem; non ex operibus, ne quis glorietur. Quoniam sumus Dei opus, sive factura, creati in Christo Jesu ad opera bona, quae praeparavit Deus ut in illis am-bulemus. Ubi docet nos a peccatis nostris servari, seu liberari, non vi & merito operum nostrorum, sed per gratiam illam qua Deus non solum nobis peccata condonat, sed nos etiam virtute Spiritus Sancti quasi de novo creat, ut novi homines facti, deinceps pie & juste vivamus, & studeamus operibus bonis.
pass_a_gloss: Looking to which the same Apostle in Ephesians 2 says that we have been made alive together with Christ and saved by grace through faith; not of works, lest anyone should boast. For we are God's workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared beforehand that we should walk in them. Where he teaches that we are saved or freed from our sins not by the force and merit of our works, but by that grace by which God not only pardons our sins but also by the power of the Holy Spirit as it were newly creates us, so that, made new men, we thereafter live piously and justly and pursue good works.
pass_b_english: Eph 2: made alive with Christ, saved by grace through faith, not of works; God's workmanship created for good works.
Grace both pardons and newly creates so we live justly afterward.
